boundaries: The source label 40, active track and handle are independent authoring facts. Snapshot geometry preserves the 3px handle-center/track-end offset and non-centered 19px bubble; it never parses label text or infers native value from pixels.

Gallery controls are native Z_Slider instances with an explicit demo value fixture, NoFocus and transparent mouse events. Native interactivity is provided on Appearance, where geometry derives from QStyleOptionSlider and QSlider values.
snapshotState changes appearance only; it never sets sliderDown, focus, tracking or value. Actual pointer, wheel, keyboard, page steps, inversion, RTL and signals remain QSlider-owned.
Qt 5.15.2 disabling calls setSliderDown(false), which commits a pending sliderPosition even if the slider was not pressed. Preserve this native commit boundary; disabling is not cancellation.
Show value and Value label are explicit composition properties, not native QSlider setters. Null label follows sliderPosition; arbitrary labels remain independent text.

Native tickPosition/tickInterval remain authoritative outside the gallery snapshot. Dense ranges are thinned only by whole interval multiples to at most 2049 ticks per side; no value or range modification.

Live bubble bounds are clamped horizontally; vertical live labels are elided in a 33px slot to avoid obscuring the track. The inspector retains full label and native numeric values. Authored snapshots retain exact source bounds.
Captured Light is not four-theme parity, normalized export readiness, or designer approval.
